initial_analysis: This is a high-initiative battle with both squads featuring I5-I6 aces. My squad has a significant durability advantage with Chiraneau's massive 16 effective HP and Vader's 7 HP with 3 agility. The enemy has Fenn Rau as their glass cannon ace (4 HP, 0 shields) and Boba Fett as their anchor. Tapusk is likely running support/coordinate abilities. Key insight: Vader at I6 moves after Fenn Rau and shoots simultaneously - this is critical for the ace duel. Chiraneau at I5 can be blocked by Boba/Tapusk but provides massive firepower. Magna Tolvan is our weak link at I3 with no shields - she will move first and be vulnerable.
my_squad_strengths: Initiative advantage with Vader at I6 - moves after Fenn, shoots same time
Massive combined HP pool (16+7+3 = 26 effective HP vs enemy's ~19)
Chiraneau is extremely tanky and can reinforce
Vader's 3 agility Defender is hard to kill and has white evade
No reliance on single fragile piece - we have redundancy
my_squad_weaknesses: Magna Tolvan is fragile at 3HP/0S and moves at I3 - easy prey for Fenn
Chiraneau has 0 agility - will take consistent damage
Large base Decimator can be blocked easily
If Vader goes down early, we lose our ace-killer
Low overall ship count means each loss is significant
enemy_threats: Fenn Rau - 5 dice at R1 with Concordia Faceoff, can one-shot Tolvan or cripple any ship
Boba Fett - rear arc threat and likely has Slave I title for repositioning, very durable
Tapusk - HWK support ship likely coordinating Fenn or Boba for extra actions, kill the enabler

ship_roles.chiraneau: anchor - use large base and massive HP to control engagement, reinforce when focused, deal consistent damage
ship_roles.vader: ace_hunter - primary job is to kill Fenn Rau, use I6 repositioning to get good arcs while denying Fenn's bonus attacks
ship_roles.tolvan: blocker - use I3 movement to block Boba or Tapusk, keep her at range 3 when possible, expendable if it creates opportunities

opponent_tendencies: Unknown - observing. Watch for: Does Fenn joust or flank? Does Tapusk stay back or fly in formation? Is Boba aggressive or reserved?
